# PanePilot v0.17.0

PanePilot 0.17.0 makes browsing files, actions, and sub-agents easier to keep under control.

- Files open in one reusable temporary tab. Click its tab or double-click a file
  to keep it open; editing protects the tab and its draft automatically.
- Drag Actions into your preferred order. Each project also remembers its last
  selected action when you return, without running it again.
- Working sub-agents appear first, with finished agents at the end. A small dot on
  the Sub-agents toolbar button indicates running work only—no completion alerts.

## Update or download

In PanePilot v0.16.0 or newer, open **More toolbar actions → Check for updates…**,
then use **Restart to update** after saving your drafts. Installation is never
automatic. Earlier public releases require one manual installation from the DMG
or ZIP.

The downloads support Apple silicon Macs running macOS 12 or newer. They are ad-hoc
signed and not Apple-notarized; Sparkle signatures verify updates, not Apple
developer identity. Verify downloads with the attached `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

Persistent tmux sessions remain available for reconnection. Plain PTY terminals do
not survive app exit, and SSH port forwards must be reopened after restarting.
